newsitem.title: USA: Liberty buys $63.2 mln Minneapolis portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Liberty buys $63.2 mln Minneapolis portfolio.

text.p: Liberty Property Trust said Thursday that it bought 17 properties in metropolitan Minneapolis for about $63.2 million.
The properties are expected to contribute immediately to Liberty's bottom line, as well as significant growth in the future, said the company.

Liberty said the transaction covered buildings with 1,020,000 square feet of space. All are in the suburbs, with the exception of one downtown Minneapolis office building. The properties, the company added, are 94 percent leased, and were bought at a current yield of 10.1 percent.
The transaction, said Liberty, marks its entry into the Minneapolis market.
The company intends to increase the size of its Minneapolis portfolio through strategic acquisitions and development.
Liberty Property Trust is a self-administered real estate investment trust.
